summary: ais-catcher 0.70+lab1: AIS-catcher v0.70 (8833c64) for the AIS engine lease; RTL-SDR (lab librtlsdr2) and Airspy HF+ input only, ZLIB; no TLS, web viewer, database, message-bus, NMEA2000 or other SDR drivers; bias-tee call compiled out

packages.name: ais-catcher
packages.description: AIS receiver for the SR-RX engine lease, receive-only lab build (RTL-SDR and Airspy HF+, no network outputs compiled for TLS, web or databases)

notes: Every option() of the pinned tree is explicit (CMakeLists.txt:42-61, :89, :94-95): RTLSDR, AIRSPYHF and ZLIB ON, all others OFF. OPENSSL, WEBVIEWER, ZMQ, PSQL, SQLITE and NMEA2000 OFF remove the HTTPS upload, the embedded web server, the message-bus and database outputs and the NMEA2000 push at build time, a second layer under IPAddressDeny=any of the lease unit; the plain TCP/UDP/HTTP/MQTT outputs, the RTL-TCP/SpyServer inputs and the aiscatcher.org community-feed TCP client (Source/Application/AIS-catcher.h:28-29) are always compiled upstream. v0.70 turns the community feed ON by default as soon as any output such as -f exists (Source/Application/Main.cpp:1077-1086) and only -X off disables it (Main.cpp:923-936), so the reviewed ExecStart carries -X off and runtime_check.py asserts it from the engine's stderr; the rest is excluded by the reviewed ExecStart (selftest RX-12-ais) and by the unit's IP filter.

SOXR and SAMPLERATE OFF: the lease runs RTL-SDR at the AIS-catcher default 1536000 and HF+ at 192000 (srrx.ais_filter SAMPLE_RATES), both in the v0.70 model's own downsampler list (Source/DSP/Model.cpp:128-129); 192000 is in the airspyhf rate list of STACK.md:143.

HASRTLSDR_BIASTEE=0 pre-sets the check_function_exists result (cmake/dependencies/RTLSDR.cmake:37-44), so -gr BIASTEE never reaches rtlsdr_set_bias_tee: Source/Device/RTLSDR.cpp:198-199 then throws 'bias tee not supported'. The forbid_strings check proves that the symbol is not imported; the lab librtlsdr2 keeps GPIO0 off as well (V4L-0, ПОЛ-03).

Version string: without .git the tree's commit hash is 'unknown' and RUN_NUMBER is fixed at 0 (CMakeLists.txt:13-35), so VERSION_DESCRIBE is constant; __DATE__ (Source/Application/Main.cpp:73) follows SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH of the archive (GCC), and repeat=true checks the .deb bytes.
lab_build_depends librtlsdr2 and librtlsdr-dev: AIS-catcher links the patched lab librtlsdr.so.2 (dpkg-shlibdeps gives librtlsdr2 >= 2.0.3-0+lab1), libairspyhf from noble (STACK.md:902).

Only the AIS-catcher binary is installed (CMakeLists.txt:406). runtime_check.py replays synthetic AIVDM through the built binary (the FIFO run with exactly the lease's output arguments, -X off included) and checks the JSON_FULL keys that srrx.ais_filter reads and that the community feed is disabled; reception on the Q6A (HF+ at 162 MHz, RTL-A) stays a device row.
